# Unified Ontology of Human Function (UOHF)

Canonical UOHF repository: https://github.com/dlehche/Unified-Ontology-Of-Human-Function
Downstream HFWM repository: https://github.com/dlehche/Human-Function-World-Model

## Core identity

UOHF is the governed semantic and computational ontology for human function.

Human function is the body's capacity to be appropriately engaged to meet internal and external demands.
人体功能，就是身体被正常调用的能力。

## Canonical UOHF sources

- UOHF Definition 2.1: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21630406
- A Formal Framework for Human Function in UOHF: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21721599
- Unification in UOHF: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21635694
- Human Function Capacity System V1.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21975100

## Repository scope

This repository is authoritative for UOHF definitions, ontology identities, type boundaries, governed relations, formal human-function semantics, the public 18-core/104-specific capacity coordinate, and UOHF version governance.

HFWM is a downstream world-model and model-coordination layer. Its canonical source repository is:
https://github.com/dlehche/Human-Function-World-Model

Current related HFWM publications:
- HFWM Version 1.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22685308
- Human-model interoperability Version 1.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23180973

The downstream HFWM publications are related to UOHF but are not part of the UOHF publication/version sequence.

## Claim boundary

UOHF does not claim completed clinical validation of all capacities, universal model compatibility, autonomous diagnosis or treatment, or public release of the complete production ontology and reasoning system.
